source_identity.limitation: Per-file and review-scope fingerprints identify inspected source only. HEAD is the comparison base, not a commit attesting execution of this working tree.

scope: Changes since 70d28af in bounded context, backup validation and prompt provenance
Runtime cancellation, model-cache and capture-profile identities
Read-only permission status versus explicit OS permission requests
Vendored eframe 0.35 child AccessKit initialization patch

findings.trigger: Restore an otherwise accepted legacy backup containing a completed request with no matching suggestion, then create another request and export/restore its backup.
findings.effect_before_fix: Selection counted only completed request/answer pairs, but validation counted all completed requests; the new snapshot omission identity could make its own backup non-restorable.
findings.correction: Selection and validation consistently count completed requests that have matching stored responses. The accepted legacy request and human notes remain preserved without inventing an answer.

findings.trigger: Restore a valid-shaped backup whose session context_revision is u64::MAX, then perform a context-changing operation.
findings.effect_before_fix: Unchecked increment could panic in debug or wrap in release. The new request path exposed this existing shared unchecked-increment pattern.
findings.correction: All five context-changing sites use checked addition and return an error. Transaction/local-copy boundaries preserve prior notes, transcript, requests, modes and knowledge; notes and export remain usable.

reviewed_checks.detail: New selection_version 1 retains a contiguous newest suffix of whole finalized transcript segments: at most 64 and 16 KiB of UTF-8 text; completed chat independently retains at most 8 whole turns and 16 KiB combined prompt/response text. Oversized newest items produce empty context with diagnostics; full stored history and notes remain separate.

Legacy version 0 snapshots remain readable without invented omission counts. Version 1 bounds, source quotations, prior-turn identity, omitted-item counts and paired prompt-identity fields are checked before restore transaction writes. Invalid restore preserves existing data.

Question is a distinct final user role; prior user/assistant turns use real roles; all interpolated special-token prefixes are escaped. Exact rendered UTF-8 prompt SHA-256 and template revision are persisted; store and generator omission totals use checked addition and are validated against frozen selection. Tokenizer/model identities remain separate.

Bounded generation jobs freeze request/root/profile/cancellation identity. Cache key contains root and profile; changing generation profile cancels old work. Live ASR events carry the capture job profile, preserving actual provenance across preference changes. Cancelled/superseded events cannot complete a current request by ID alone.

Runtime initialization and RefreshPermissions call status(), which uses OS preflight/authorization-status reads only. OS request APIs occur in explicit acquisition helpers. Microphone callback sends one bounded boolean; wait polls cancellation every 50 ms with a 60 s timeout, then capture checks stop again before starting. Denial/disconnection fail closed; late callback does not itself acquire audio.

Canonical active-database/sidecar protection remains, with same_file::is_same_file for existing hard-link aliases across platforms. Existing hard-link regression remains present. Shared atomic private export publication remains in place. No Windows execution by evaluator.

Patch initializes child wgpu adapters at native window creation with the existing event-loop proxy. Immediate/deferred paths pass the proxy, root initialization remains separate, and existing window-ID to viewport action routing and platform output handling remain in use. Cfg guards preserve non-AccessKit compilation paths by inspection.

vendor_integrity.upstream: eframe 0.35.0 from locally available Cargo registry source
vendor_integrity.claim_limit: Confirms the local upstream comparison and declared patch scope. It does not establish native accessibility behavior or independently verify statements about newer upstream releases.

coordinated_test_note: Engine owner reported normal checks passing after the two fixes. This evaluator inspected test source and did not rerun cargo or model inference; exact execution evidence belongs to the separate coordinated report.
methods: Read git diff against 70d28af and connected source/callers/tests.
Traced backup trust-boundary edge cases and coordinated corrections with engine owner.
Re-read corrected eligibility and every checked revision-increment call site.
Compared vendored eframe files byte-for-byte with available upstream 0.35.0 source, checked declared hashes and inspected adapter/event/output routing.
limits: No CUA, GUI launch, focus action, OS grant, permission prompt, actual microphone/system capture or inference rerun by evaluator.
Child native accessibility remains pending actual post-handoff verification. Headless widget semantics are not native AX proof.
No real permission denial/revocation, native late-grant/cancel timing, device unplug, sleep/resume or sustained-operation run by evaluator.
No Windows/Linux runtime or clean-install acceptance. Cross-platform source routing is not platform runtime evidence.
Prompt digests identify rendered input; old missing provenance remains unknown and explicit source deletion can make an old prompt irreproducible.
Review covers the listed source snapshot and high-impact workflows, not an exhaustive codebase/security audit or whole-product parity pass.
prior_reports: Preserved; this review is a new original report.
